title: CLCON/21/2014 of Munni Arya Vs Prem Nath Tyagi AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 21 of 2014
Honíble Alok Singh, J.
 Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, Advocate
for the contempt applicant.
 Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, Senior
Advocate assisted by Mr. Sunil
Upadhyay, Advocate for OP No. 1.
 Mrs. Bina Pande, Standing
Counsel (Uttar Pradesh) for OP No. 2.
 For the reason stated in the
application, counter affidavit filed on
behalf of respondent no. 2 is taken on
record. CLMA No. 6056 of 2014 stands
disposed of accordingly.
 Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, learned
Senior Counsel appearing for OP No. 1
has handed over Demand Draft No.
253696 of Bank of India dated
5.6.2014 of Rs. 50,000/- favouring
Smt. Munni Arya/applicant to Sri
Yogesh Pacholia, learned counsel for
the applicant, in the Court.
 Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, learned
counsel appearing for the contempt
applicant, in view of the above, seeks
permission to withdraw this contempt
application.
 Permitted to be withdrawn.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 18.6.2014
Avneet
